channel.title: Jaeheung Lee | Manufacturing & Process Engineer
channel.description: Manufacturing and process-engineering portfolio covering battery production, semiconductor components, equipment FAT/SAT, quality improvement, and manufacturing DX

item.title: 2170 Assembly-Line Yield Stabilization
item.description: Displayed yield, actual good yield, and shop-floor defects did not agree, so measurement and decision reliability had to be checked before process settings. The team recorded 98.7% monthly average good yield in December 2024, and I directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.

item.title: 4695 Production Transition Validation
item.description: Development was complete, but no equipment could run normally from start to finish, so production-start conditions were rechecked from an initial SAT-level baseline. A representative automatic cycle was restored, and two 100-cell lots plus the final 50 cells were used as production-start evidence. Long-term production stability was separate.

item.title: 25P LFP Cell Development
item.description: The overseas-customer LFP power cell had substantial material and structure changes, so legacy impregnation, welding, and inspection conditions could not be reused directly. The project advanced through A/B/C samples, about 20,000-cell trial production, and customer qualification and production approval in March 2025, but commercial production did not proceed because of pricing.

item.title: 2170 Tabless A-Sample Build Validation
item.description: A collector-based Tabless structure differed from the lead-tab process and could not be repeated without dedicated jigs and inspection methods. Five samples suitable for functional evaluation were secured from about 100 exploratory builds. Repeat production, manufacturability, and statistical superiority were not verified at this A-sample stage.

item.title: NCM Prismatic Pilot-Line Acceptance and Initial Stabilization
item.description: Limited FAT samples and individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, repeatability, or readiness for actual production. The team observed an initial snapshot of about 95% over roughly five days and 1,000 cells, including cells meeting criteria after rework, and documented FAT/SAT, MSA, and operating standards. It is not FPY or long-term production yield.

item.title: Alternative Can Supplier Pilot Transition
item.description: The incumbent supplier could not cover the planned follow-on volume alone, so a new can supplier required manufacturing and quality validation. After 600 cells across three lots and an official UN38.3 pass, purchasing and subsequent pilot production moved to the alternative can after existing stock was consumed.

item.title: NCM Pre-Forming Process Validation
item.description: Manual shaping before pre-welding varied by operator and repeatedly created uncoated-edge damage and short-circuit risk. The condition was verified with about 400 samples, used in subsequent pilot production, and reflected in process/inspection standards, the P-FMEA, and production-equipment RFQ.

item.title: Cell S/N Production-History Trace Tool
item.description: Process-level MES data existed, but a cell's full history was not connected, so investigating ten customer-requested cells took about three days. A single search took 5–10 seconds and a ten-cell investigation about three minutes; the tool was used on site during my employment and handed over.

item.title: Vacuum-Robot Overhaul Standardization
item.description: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. Rework and overtime were observed to decrease, while team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.

item.title: High-Temperature Anodizing Film Development for OLED Parts
item.description: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition from legacy-condition parts.

item.title: Technical Qualification of CVD and PECVD Components
item.description: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. Repeated same-sample measurements identified differences in internal and customer equipment and decision methods, and the technical-qualification conditions were added to QCPs, run sheets, and inspection standards.

item.title: Diffuser Ultrasonic Stripping Scale-up Failure Analysis
item.description: Lab stripping was possible, but overlapping ultrasonic zones damaged the surface and left roughness, diffusion, and reusability risks unresolved. Normal operation was not achieved; the case established that stripping feasibility and product reusability must be judged separately.

item.title: Building an AI Model to Find Defects in Welding Images
item.description: A model trained on public material still had to be checked on separately captured samples under different conditions. The five-person team completed a training PoC comparing error changes with missed-defect and reinspection burden. Independent testing and production use remain separate.

item.title: Factory I/O Virtual Factory Expansion Scenario
item.description: Meeting a target output required checking cycle time, equipment count, and layout before adding equipment. The ten-person team demonstrated a virtual production flow and target-output scenario. AI control and real-plant measurement were not performed.

item.title: Indy7 Robot Digital Twin Implementation Project
item.description: JSON references had to survive exchanges between the PC and teaching pendant, while the robot command and status-monitoring paths needed one coherent flow. The team connected an automotive assembly scenario to a physical Indy7 demonstration, while the public repository verifies my command/status paths and read-only Web Twin implementation.

item.title: YMC Surface-Treatment and Process-Development Case Hub
item.description: Combining development, qualification, and failure in one article blurred each case's decisions and outcomes. A YMC career-navigation page connecting the OLED production-development, CVD/PECVD technical-qualification, and Diffuser failure cases.

item.title: HeungTology for Collecting and Searching Manufacturing Knowledge
item.description: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. The verified scope is Markdown source management, changed-file synchronization, and candidate retrieval and reranking. It is not an operating service or automated quality decision system.

item.title: Deep Learning Model Study Log
item.description: Running example code is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained again. The current public artifact is a learning checklist. Executable code, a fixed set, reproduced results, and model performance are not public achievements.

item.title: Study Masterbook for Maintenance Engineer Exam Candidates
item.description: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.

item.title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions
item.description: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.

item.title: Checking Evidence and Approval Before AI Takes Action
item.description: An AI reading material and proposing work does not grant execution authority or prove safe completion. The public scope is an initial design for evidence, approval, stop, and result-verification checks. An external execution system and authorization UI are not completed results.
